description: ERECTION OF A SINGLE-STOREY REAR, SIDE AND PART FRONT EXTENSION WITH PROVISION OF FRONT PORCH.
decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - Commencement of development (Full Permission) - The development to which this permission relates shall be commenced not later than the expiration of 3 years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 2 - Approved Plans - The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans: [N/01,
N/02
N/06,
N/07,
N/08,
N/09]
Condition : 3 - Materials as Specified - The facing materials to be used for the development hereby permitted shall be those specified in the application form unless otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority.
Condition : 4 - No Use of Flat Roof  - Access to the flat roof of the development hereby permitted shall be for maintenance or emergency purposes only, and the flat roof shall not be used as a roof garden, terrace, patio or similar amenity area.
Condition : 5 - The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in full accordance with the flood risk mitigation measures set out in the approved plans and documents. These measures shall ensure that:
1.	Floor levels within the proposed development are set no lower than the existing ground levels with appropriate flood proofing incorporated where required; or
2.	Floor levels within the extension are set a minimum of 300mm above the known or modelled 1 in 100 annual probability river flood event (1%) or the 1 in 200 annual probability sea flood event (0.5%).
The approved flood resilience measures shall be implemented during construction and retained thereafter for the lifetime of the development.

Reason: To ensure the development incorporates appropriate flood risk mitigation measures in accordance with policy SI 13 of the London Plan 2021
Condition : 6 - INFORMATIVE
Note to Applicant -Approved Schemes
In accordance with paragraph 38 of the National Planning Policy Framework, London Borough of Merton (LBM) takes a positive and proactive approach to the delivery of sustainable development, by:
1. Providing a formal pre-application advice service, details to be found on Planning pre-application advice service on LBM's website
2. Providing written policies and guidance, which is available to view on LBM's website.
3. Where appropriate, negotiating amendments to secure a positive decision.
4. Determining applications in a timely manner including providing a fast track service, details to be found on Get a quicker planning decision on LBM's website.

In this instance:
i) The application was acceptable as submitted, and approved [with an agreed determination date].



Condition : 7 - INFORMATIVE
Building Regulations

If you are in any doubt about this you can get further information via https://www.merton.gov.uk/planning-and-buildings/building-control  or by emailing building.control@merton.gov.uk.
